result.title: TOGBench: Benchmarking and Improving Tiny-Object Generation Fidelity in Aerial Imagery
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 Round 2. 20 pages, 7 figures
result.summary: Advances in deep generative models now enable the synthesis of realistic imagery. However, aerial imagery is dominated by tiny objects, such as vehicles, ships, and aircraft, which occupy only a few pixels owing to the overhead, wide-area nature of aerial imaging. Existing generative models struggle substantially more with tiny objects than with larger ones. This limitation has been overlooked, as prior work on generative evaluation emphasizes prompt following or human preference rather than whether small objects are rendered faithfully. To address this gap, we introduce TOGBench, a quantitative, object-level benchmark for evaluating tiny-object generation fidelity in aerial imagery. We further propose two simple train-/inference-time techniques that improve the ability of layout-to-image generators to render small objects, raising their performance on TOGBench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TOGBench，一个面向航拍图像的对象级定量基准，用于评估生成模型对小目标（车辆、船舶、飞机等仅占数像素的物体）的渲染保真度，并提出两种训练/推理期简单技巧改善 layout-to-image 生成器的小目标生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 属图像生成评估而非 LVR 主线，但其按对象尺度分层、以对象为单位判定细小视觉内容是否忠实保留的评测思路，可能可供核查用于诊断 latent 状态中细小视觉实体的信息坍缩与细节丢失。
